scenarios.scenario: Change the selected document in thumbnail view

scenario_steps.name: writable copies of `fixtures/cad/document-opening/OpenDrawingA.odd`, `OpenDrawingB.odd` and `OpenPart.opd` are staged in the same working folder
the user opens and saves each drawing to establish its sheet preview, then closes the drawings
the Open dialog in the MCAD Software displays a saved drawing and a saved part as thumbnails
the drawing thumbnail is selected with its sheet preview displayed
the Options pane shows the drawing loading choices
the working folder contains `OpenDrawingA.odd` and `OpenPart.opd` as thumbnails
the user selects the part thumbnail
the part thumbnail is highlighted
the file name field identifies the part
the separate preview displays the part geometry
the Options pane displays Model State and Design View controls
the dialog remains open

scenarios.scenario: Inspect a file context menu without opening the document

scenario_steps.name: the Open dialog in the MCAD Software displays a saved part as a thumbnail
the part is selected with its file name and preview displayed
`fixtures/cad/extrusion/extrusion-rect-8mm.opd` is selected as a thumbnail
the user right-clicks the part thumbnail
a context menu appears with Open, Copy, Rename and Properties choices
the part name and preview remain displayed behind the menu
the user clicks an empty area of the file list
the context menu closes
the selected-item count is cleared
the dialog remains open with the part name and preview displayed

scenarios.scenario: Select multiple drawing files and return to one

scenario_steps.name: writable copies of `fixtures/cad/document-opening/OpenDrawingA.odd`, `OpenDrawingB.odd` and `OpenPart.opd` are staged in the same working folder
the user opens and saves each drawing to establish its sheet preview, then closes the drawings
the Open dialog in the MCAD Software displays two adjacent saved drawings as thumbnails
each drawing has a saved sheet preview
the dialog folder contains adjacent `OpenDrawingA.odd` and `OpenDrawingB.odd` thumbnails
the user drags a selection rectangle from empty list space across both thumbnails
both drawing thumbnails are selected
the status area reports two selected items
the file name field contains both drawing names in quotes
the separate preview area displays a placeholder
individual drawing loading options are not displayed
the user selects one of the drawing thumbnails
only that drawing is selected
the file name field identifies that drawing
its sheet preview and drawing loading options are displayed
the Open dialog remains open
